title: DPYC Social Contract Member Record
description: Schema for an individual member file in the members/ directory.

npub.description: Nostr public key in bech32 format.

role.description: Member's role in the Social Contract.

status.description: Current standing in the community. inactive: in good standing and kept on record, but not serving at present; listings leave it out.

services.description: Services operated by this member: MCP servers, and any plain HTTP endpoints they depend on.

upstream_authority_npub.description: npub of the member's upstream Authority. Null for prime_authority.

ban_reason.description: Reason for ban — link to GitHub Issue.

transport.description: How the endpoint is reached. mcp (the default when absent): an MCP server over streamable HTTP. http: a plain web endpoint, such as a browser callback, that is not an MCP and is never probed as one.
